— COMMON QUESTIONS —

Pricing & Process FAQs

What makes Digital Digix different from other agencies?＋

We focus on pure results with no long-term lock-in retainer traps, and we provide transparent pay-per-performance execution led directly by founders.

How long before I see SMM results?＋

While organic SEO takes months, our SMM campaigns deliver high-quality engagement, viral reels, and targeted lead generation within 24 to 72 hours of ad campaigns going live.

Is there a lock-in contract?＋

Absolutely not. All our social media marketing packages are billed month-to-month. You are free to scale up, scale down, or cancel at any time with no penalties.

Is post-pay available at Digital Digix?＋

Yes, we offer pay-after-results or pay-per-outcome performance setups for qualified brands after aligning on upfront lead definitions and targets.

Do you offer B2B or agency discounts?＋

Yes! Our B2B & Agency Tiers provide up to 20% off for partners managing multiple client accounts under white-label execution.

Which package should I choose?＋

The Starter package is great for brand consistency, the Growth package is perfect for active lead generation, and the Pro package is designed for maximum market dominance.
